run_read_calibration: run a python module to read calibration data from a VRS file using sensors.getCalibStrFromFile
run_list_sensors: run a python module to list all cameras, IMUs, magnetometers, barometers, and microphones from a DeviceModel
run_project_unproject: run a python module to project 3D points to 2D image space and unproject back using camera calibration
run_transform_points: run a python module to transform 3D points between camera and IMU sensor frames using device.transform
run_rectify_imu: run a python module to rectify IMU accelerometer measurements by compensating for systematic errors
